configuration.bandwidth_source: AMD DS987 K26 SOM data sheet: 64-bit DDR4 at 2400Mb/s;19.2GB/s theoretical,9.6GB/s assumed50% efficiency. See experiments/SOURCES.md.
configuration.changes: Independent direct integer layer engine with global float scratch arrays. Probe global-port INTERFACE support without changing any srcnn argument.
configuration.conclusion: If global m_axi is unsupported, preserve the failure and record scratch-pointer contract as pending human decision; proceed with tile fusion.

estimates.basis: Three sequential T32 layer schedules,251 dedicated MACs plus3 boundary converters. Full feature maps are external DDR only if both scratch AXI ports exist. DDR payload includes two writes/two reads of float64/32-channel features, float IO and all parameters; csynth omits realistic DDR stalls.

configuration.interpretation: Require both scratch AXI bundles before interpreting this as a DDR implementation. Compare ideal sequential cycles with reported memory-port stalls and report bandwidth lower bounds separately.
configuration.name: ddr_global_probe
configuration.purpose: Can the fixed srcnn signature expose two global feature arrays through m_axi? Execute each layer sequentially with float carriers for quantized features. The scratch arrays must become real external ports; ignored/rejected pragmas invalidate this DDR experiment. No supplied input/output buffer is used out of bounds.
